description.translate: Eight pieces of glass should close these windows. Rain has already blurred too many pages. We must preserve what remains before we decide what it means. Hand the materials to me one at a time.

The source was already inside the sword: the Warden's captured call. The Ranker amplified it beyond the limit I had marked. Sound carried force through the frame until the assembly failed. Nothing beneath the earth had answered us. Our own experiment had gone wrong.
